events.name: Bash
events.head: Check task state, deck history, and done-when grep
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -30; echo ---; git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/build app/public/materials/deck.html; echo ---; git status --short | head -20; echo ---; git grep -i -c -E 'apollo|sendgrid|godaddy|builtwith|neverbounce|zerobounce|instantly' -- workshop-plan/deck.html; echo "grep rc=$?"; grep -n -i 'proof point\|Growth Idea' workshop-plan/build/content.py | head; cmp workshop-plan/deck.html app/public/materials/deck.html && echo identical; git status -sb | head -1; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the part of the output after the board dump

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare the live deck with the source and check the remote copy
events.input: $ curl -sL "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/deck.html?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/deck_live.html; cmp /tmp/deck_live.html workshop-plan/deck.html && echo LIVE_IDENTICAL; grep -c -i -E 'apollo|sendgrid|godaddy|builtwith|neverbounce|zerobounce|instantly|Add your own proof point' /tmp/deck_live.html; grep -c 'Growth Idea, webinar #4, August 2025' /tmp/deck_live.html; git log origin/main --oneline -1 -- workshop-plan/deck.html; git diff --stat origin/main -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/build | tail -1; ls workshop-plan/probe-deck*.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: See what differs from the remote and run both deck probes
events.input: $ git diff --stat origin/main -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/build; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD -- workshop-plan/build workshop-plan/deck.html; cd workshop-plan && (node probe-deck.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6; echo "rc=$?"; node probe-deck-nav.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4)

events.name: Bash
